stages.c: A couple buying their first home in Bath. Twenty minutes on the phone, a fixed fee agreed, and a file opened the same day.
The contract pack from the seller's solicitor, ID, the mortgage offer and the searches, all in one place.
Every document read and filed: identity, title, searches, money. Nothing waits in an inbox.
Three things flagged: a shared drive, a missing building certificate, and a service charge that rises in two years.
A two-page report in plain English, what each point means for you and what we've asked the seller to fix.
Contracts exchanged, money moved, keys collected at noon. The file closes with a letter you'll actually keep.

guide.title: Tell us what's happening. We'll tell you what happens next.
guide.sub: Pick the area and what's going on. You'll see who'd handle it, what it usually costs, how long it takes and what to have ready for the first call.

steps: We check the contract pack and order searches
We report on anything that affects you, in plain English
We exchange, complete and register you as owner
sits.bring: Your ID, the agent's details and your mortgage offer if you have one.

steps: We prepare the contract pack and answer the buyer's questions
We agree dates and exchange
We complete, pay off the mortgage and send you the rest
sits.bring: Your ID, the title deeds if you have them, and any guarantees or certificates.

steps: We get a valuation and serve the notice
We negotiate the premium with the landlord
We draw up and register the new lease
sits.bring: Your current lease and any letters from the landlord.

steps: We read the agreement and tell you if the money is fair
We negotiate better terms where we can
We sign the adviser's certificate so you get paid
sits.bring: The draft agreement and your contract of employment.

steps: We assess your claim and the deadlines
We start early conciliation through Acas
We negotiate, or take it to tribunal
sits.bring: Your contract, the dismissal letter and any emails about it.

steps: We talk through your family and what you want
We draft the will and explain every clause
We witness the signing and store the original free
sits.bring: A list of what you own and who you want to look after things.

steps: We help you choose attorneys and set instructions
We prepare and sign the forms with you
We register them with the Office of the Public Guardian
sits.bring: The names and addresses of your attorneys and a certificate provider.

steps: We value the estate and apply for the grant
We collect the money in and pay the debts
We pay out the gifts and close the estate
sits.bring: The will, the death certificate and any bank or pension letters.

steps: We learn how your business sells
We draft terms that fit and protect you
We walk you through them so you can use them
sits.bring: What you sell, how you take payment, and any terms you use now.

steps: We send a formal letter before action
We negotiate payment or a plan
We issue a claim if they still won't pay
sits.bring: The invoice, the contract or order, and any messages about it.

fees.title: The price first, in writing.
fees.sub: Most of our work is fixed fee. You'll know the number before we start, and it won't move unless the job does, which we'll tell you about first.

incl: Advice on the terms and the money
A meeting in person or by video
Drafting and one round of changes

fees.note: Third-party costs such as search fees, Land Registry fees and court fees are extra and passed on at cost. We list them in your quote.

people.title: The person you speak to does the work.
people.sub: No handing you down a chain. Your solicitor is named on the first call and stays with you to the end.
